stage_a_summary.note: PR-AUC is measured strictly out-of-fold against catalogue pixels. It screens detector quality only; the paired-DTI criterion is applied in Stage B.

d3.exploratory_note: the signed-dP and second-moment rankings were added as disclosed exploratory neighbours AFTER |dP| was found to be quantised to {-1,0,+1} x P/n_ge; the registered gate is the |dP| one and it is the one that decides
d3.note: Pooled efficiency = credit gained / false-positive weight, set added to an empty base (the Addendum-B definition). Hidden truth is catalogue-internal.
d3.reaggregated_from_stored_cells: the run's own _d3_verdict omitted the two exploratory pools (a reporting bug, fixed in the script); they are recomputed here from the stored per-cell rows, which were written by the registered run and are unchanged
